title: nasturtium islandicum
intro: Nasturtium islandicum, commonly known as the Gloriosa islandica, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Colchicaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may help reduce pain, swelling, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Nasturtium islandicum include its ability to modulate the immune system and its potential antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include colchicine, a glycoside responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other alkaloids that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
